title: Overpowering Scent!!
text:
Overpowering Scent!!. This came on time and was definitely well packaged. It was doubled bagged. Which is good!

Pros: Frankincence and Myrrh and dragons blood are the best smelling when burned. The Incense holder is a good design to where you can burn 2 sticks at time.

Cons: As soon as I opened the bag that the box was in, The scent was overpowering. All i could smell was Sage for a few hours. These are not very long lasting when you burn them. 10-15 mins depending on what you burn. A good incense should last 45 mins to an hour.

Overall you get what you pay for. Some good scents in this package, but the sage was way too overpowering. That’s what you get for cheap Incense.
